title: Modded multi
subtitle: Play custom maps with friends: host or join a Rocket Plugin game over Tailscale, without Easy Anti-Cheat.
offlineNote: Modded games run without Easy Anti-Cheat (offline mode): every player needs Tailscale, BakkesMod with Rocket Plugin and the same map. The app only starts the tools you installed: it never injects anything itself.

host.title: Host a game
host.description: Pick a map and the Labs arena it replaces. The app installs it (unless it is already there), starts the game and BakkesMod, opens the game on Rocket Plugin, then gives you a code for your friends.

host.alreadyThere: Already installed over {{arena}}: nothing to rewrite.
host.willInstall: Will be installed over the {{arena}} arena while you play.
host.arenaShared: The arena is in the invite code: your friends' app uses the same one. If someone installs the map by hand, tell them which arena.

mutators.description: Like a private match: anything left on Default keeps the game's default.

join.title: Join a friend
join.description: Paste the code from the host. The app checks you have the same map and offers the download if needed; Join then installs it over the host's arena, starts the game and BakkesMod, and connects.
join.alreadyThere: Already installed over {{arena}}: nothing to reinstall.
join.inLibrary: In your library ({{name}}): installed over {{arena}} when you join.

join.missingImport: Not in your library and the host imported it from a file: ask them for it, then import it in Maps.
join.needsRepair: The host plays this map repaired with mapping v{{version}}: create the same repaired copy (identical file guaranteed).
join.repairUnavailable: The host repaired this map with mapping v{{version}}, which your app does not have yet: update ALXS-RL-Mod.

session.invite: Invite code — send it to your friends
session.manual: Type this in the BakkesMod console (F6)
session.again: Command (to type in the BakkesMod console if nothing happened)

epic.title: Start Rocket League from Epic
epic.hint: In the Epic Games Launcher, click ⋯ next to Rocket League, then "Launch without Anti-Cheat". The app picks up from there (BakkesMod, then Rocket Plugin).

byHand.title: Start the match in Rocket Plugin
byHand.hint: Open Rocket Plugin's window (its key is set in BakkesMod → Plugins → Rocket Plugin), pick the {{arena}} arena and your options, then Host. Send the invite code to your friends: their app installs the same map over the same arena.

issue.epicTitle: The Epic Games Launcher did not open
issue.bakkesSmartAppControl: Windows Smart App Control blocked BakkesMod.exe (it is not signed). It has no exception list: turn it off in Windows Security › App & browser control › Smart App Control settings, then start the session again. On some Windows builds it cannot be turned back on without resetting Windows.
issue.bakkesBlocked: Windows blocked BakkesMod.exe (an app-control policy or the antivirus). Allow it, or start BakkesMod yourself: the session goes on once it injects.
issue.bakkesMissing: BakkesMod.exe was not found in its usual folders. Start BakkesMod yourself: the session goes on once it injects.
issue.bakkesFailed: Start BakkesMod yourself: the session goes on once it injects. ({{detail}})
issue.epicNotOpened: Open the Epic Games Launcher yourself, then ⋯ next to Rocket League › "Launch without Anti-Cheat".

security.title: Lock Tailscale down to the game
security.intro: By default every device on a tailnet can reach every port of the others. For gaming you only need Rocket League's port: replace the tailnet policy so nothing else goes through.

tips.acl: In the Tailscale admin console (Access controls), replace the policy with the one below and put every player's Tailscale login in group:rl. Only UDP 7777 between players is allowed; everything else is denied.
tips.noSsh: "ssh": [] removes Tailscale SSH. Never run tailscale up --ssh on a gaming PC.
tips.noRoutes: Do not advertise an exit node or subnet routes: friends then only see your PC, not your home network.
tips.firewall: When Windows asks about Rocket League, allow it on Private networks only.
tips.cleanup: Remove a friend's device (Machines) when you stop playing together, and keep device approval on.

tailscale.title: Tailscale (every player)
tailscale.body:
Install Tailscale and sign in with a personal account (Google, Microsoft, GitHub…).
The host invites the others from the admin console: Users → Invite users. Each friend accepts with their own account, then installs Tailscale and signs in.
The host locks the tailnet down with the policy of the "Lock Tailscale down to the game" section below.
Check: every PC shows up in "Tailnet devices" on this page, and "tailscale ping <pc name>" answers.

bakkes.title: BakkesMod (every player)
bakkes.body:
Download BakkesModSetup.exe from the latest release, install it, then start it once: it updates itself.
BakkesMod only works when the game runs without Easy Anti-Cheat. With Epic, that mode is only started from the Epic Games Launcher: ⋯ next to Rocket League → "Launch without Anti-Cheat". The app opens Epic and takes over once the game is running.
After a Rocket League update, wait for BakkesMod's own update before playing (its window says it is out of date meanwhile).

rocketPlugin.title: Rocket Plugin (every player)
rocketPlugin.body:
Click Install next to Rocket Plugin in "Before playing": BakkesMod's plugin installer opens and asks you to confirm.
Without it, open the plugin's bakkesplugins page and use its Install button.
In game, BakkesMod (F2) → Plugins shows whether Rocket Plugin is enabled; its own window has a key you can set there.

app.title: ALXS-RL-Mod (every player)
app.body:
Each player needs this app, ideally the same version: it installs the map, starts everything and turns the invite code into a connection.
On each PC, open this page once: the checklist must be all green before hosting or joining.

maps.title: The map
maps.body:
The host adds maps in the Maps page (bakkesplugins download or file import).
Everyone needs the exact same file. Maps from bakkesplugins: friends get a Download button after pasting the code. Imported maps: the host sends the file, friends import it in Maps.
The host chooses which Labs arena the map replaces. It travels in the invite code, so the friends' app uses the same arena automatically.
A map already installed over that arena is not rewritten.
Many custom maps also need the custom map textures pack: install it from Maps or from "Before playing" (every player).

play.title: Playing
play.body:
Host: choose the map and the arena, click Host, start the game from Epic with "Launch without Anti-Cheat" when asked, wait for "Rocket Plugin command sent", then copy the invite code and send it.
Friends: paste the code, download the map if asked, then click Join and start the game from Epic the same way.
When the game closes, the stock arena comes back (if enabled in Settings).

trouble.title: If something goes wrong
trouble.body:
"Finish in the game": open the BakkesMod console (F6) and paste the command shown.
Friends time out: the host must already be in the game; Windows' firewall must allow Rocket League on the network type Tailscale uses; try "tailscale ping".
"Content mismatch": not the same map file on both sides — get the host's file.
